title: Return and refund policy
text: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive the item. Digital goods are refundable within 14 days if not downloaded. Shipping fees are not refunded unless the item arrived damaged or wrong.

title: Shipping times and costs
text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days (free over 50 USD, otherwise 4.99 USD). Express shipping takes 1-2 business days (12.99 USD). International delivery takes 7-14 business days and customs fees are paid by the recipient. A tracking link is emailed once the parcel ships.

title: Reset your password
text: Choose 'Forgot password' on the login page and enter your account email. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes. If you no longer have access to your email, a support agent must verify your identity.

title: Cancel or change an order
text: Orders can be cancelled or have their address changed within 1 hour of purchase from the 'My orders' page. After that the order enters fulfilment and cannot be modified; you can refuse delivery or return it instead.

title: Subscription plans and billing
text: Plans are billed monthly or yearly on the sign-up date. You can cancel any time under Settings > Billing; access continues until the end of the paid period. Invoices are available under Settings > Billing > History. Duplicate or unexpected charges must be reviewed by the billing team.

title: Warranty and damaged products
text: All hardware has a 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects. For damaged or defective items send a photo and your order number; we ship a replacement or refund at no cost. Warranty does not cover accidental damage or water damage.

title: Contact hours and channels
text: Human support is available Monday to Friday 9:00-18:00 CET by email (support@example.com) and phone (+1 555 0100). Tickets created outside these hours are answered the next business day.
